parameters.query:
SELECT
    sr.id AS student_id,
    CONCAT(sr.last_name, ' ', sr.first_name, ' ', COALESCE(sr.other_name, '')) AS full_name,
    al.level_name
FROM tb_student_registrations sr
JOIN tb_academic_levels al ON sr.level_id = al.id
WHERE al.level_name = '{{ $json.level }}'
  AND sr.admission_status = 'Active'
  -- Search: full name must contain both extracted name parts
  AND (
      LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', sr.last_name, sr.first_name, COALESCE(sr.other_name, '')))
      LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER('{{ $json.name_part_1 }}'), '%')
  )
  AND (
      LOWER(CONCAT_WS(' ', sr.last_name, sr.first_name, COALESCE(sr.other_name, '')))
      LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER('{{ $json.name_part_2 }}'), '%')
  )
  -- Security Gate: sender's phone (last 10 digits) must belong to an authorized party.
  -- NOTE: the year tutor's phone is intentionally included here -- tutors are treated
  -- as authorized for BOTH receipt submissions and text commands (balance/invoice/
  -- status/opt-out). One of the three original duplicated queries had dropped this
  -- subquery inconsistently; it is restored here for all callers.
  AND (
      RIGHT('{{ $json.sender_phone }}', 10) IN (
          RIGHT(sr.father_phone_no_1, 10), RIGHT(sr.father_phone_no_2, 10),
          RIGHT(sr.mother_phone_no_1, 10), RIGHT(sr.mother_phone_no_2, 10),
          RIGHT(sr.guardian_phone_no_1, 10), RIGHT(sr.guardian_phone_no_2, 10),
          RIGHT(sr.sponsor_phone_no_1, 10), RIGHT(sr.sponsor_phone_no_2, 10),
          (
              SELECT RIGHT(fr.faculty_phone_no_1, 10)
              FROM tb_faculty_registrations fr
              WHERE fr.id = al.year_tutor_id
          ),
          '9162583300'
      )
  );
